question: Which waterway provides connectivity with mainland India through the India- Bangladesh Protocol route?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NW-2.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NW-2:-**

 
 
• It stands for **National Waterway 2**.
 
• NW-2 is a waterway that connects mainland India with **Bangladesh** through the** India-Bangladesh Protocol route.**
 
• It is a 891 km long waterway that runs along the **Brahmaputra river from Sadiya in Assam to Dhubri**, and then along the river **Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly river** system from Haldia in West Bengal to Kolkata.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NW-10 **refers to National Waterway 10, which is the **Amba river in Maharashtra.**
 
• **NW-15** refers to National Waterway 15, which is the **Bakreswar-Mayurakshi River system in West Bengal.**
 
• **NW-83 **refers to National Waterway 83, which is the **Rajpuri creek in Maharashtra.**
